name: Linear Blend Skinning for Gaussian Splatting
aliases: Linear Blend Skinning (LBS) for Gaussian Splatting
definition: A deformation technique applied to canonical 3D Gaussians to drive human avatars, using precomputed rigid joint transformations and learnable per-Gaussian skinning weights, avoiding pose blend shapes and template vertex deformation.
summary: Linear Blend Skinning for Gaussian Splatting is a forward deformation technique that transforms 3D Gaussians from canonical to observation space using skeleton-driven rigid joint transformations and learnable per-Gaussian skinning weights.
